meta.title: Mythocarta — Interactive Map of Greek Mythology
meta.description: Explore the world of Ancient Greek mythology on an interactive map. Discover city-states, legendary rulers, and the epic voyages of Odysseus, Nestor and Agamemnon.
meta.keywords: Greek mythology, interactive map, Odysseus, Trojan War, ancient Greece, Mycenae, Troy, city-states

map.hint: Hover a city to meet its ruler
map.webglTitle: This browser can't render the map
map.webglBody: Mythocarta needs WebGL, and it isn't available in this window — common inside an embedded preview or a locked-down browser. Try opening the page in a regular browser tab.
